1d011854.axellos: inget totalmått i källan; bara delmått: Högflödespump på 5 GPM: Vår högpresterande 12V membranpump levererar ett maxflöde på 5 GPM (18,9 L/min), maxtryck på 70 PSI och en självsugande höjd på 10 fot. Tappar snabbt vatten från avlägsna tankar utan förfyllning – möjliggör korta torrstarter | Source bullets (Swedish, from the source reading): a 12 V diaphragm pump with a maximum flow of 5 GPM (18.9 L/min), a maximum pressure of 70 PSI and a self-priming height of 10 feet that draws water from remote tanks without priming and allows short dry starts; a pressure switch tested over 200,000 cycles and a bypass valve, so that the pump starts when the tap is opened and stops when it is closed, with the pressure adjustable with a hex key; a 4-chamber diaphragm pump with a pure copper motor that reduces pulsation and vibration and keeps the noise as quiet as a soft conversation at 50 dB; a 1/2 inch hose adapter, stainless steel clamps, PTFE tape and a filter that blocks larger particles; overheat and overload protection, for motorhomes, campers, outdoor kitchens, garden irrigation, sprinklers and rain barrels, with the note not waterproof and not for outdoor use. The draft text also gives a maximum self-priming height of 3 metres.
